name: SyncPass
creator: JKL Editing
description: Resolve Studio text-based rough assembly and Word edit-script export using local Whisper transcripts. Version 1.0 beta offers a 30-day trial for Windows 10/11 x64 and Apple Silicon macOS. Requires Python 3.13. Supports one video track and up to eight locked audio tracks; no J/L cuts or Linux build yet. Optional AI export shares transcripts with the assistant you choose.
